caveats: ⚑ The whole HP-loss economy is derived, not simulated: v1 has no HP pool, so the S1 self-damage line is unmodeled as an effect and instead converted into landed-hit thresholds that stand in for the HP-gated S2 branch and the HP-gated burst branch.
⚑ skill2 block 2 ATK value (86.4) assumes HP-lost plateaus near 90% of Max HP; every point of that assumption is unmeasured.

⚑ skill2 block 2 gate (hitCount 450) and burst block 2 requiresPulls (750) both assume ~100% of normal attacks land and no ally healing restores HP; a healer in the comp pushes both gates later or shuts them off entirely.
⚑ Every hitCount threshold here is expressed in LANDED normal attacks; the wall-clock time to reach each one depends on the MG cadence tuple, which comes from a datamine-unreliable field.
⚑ Both burst hits are authored crit-eligible at the caster's sheet rate; the kit text does not state crit behaviour.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Electric MG Attacker, Burst III. S1: every 30 landed normal attacks, self Critical Rate ▲9.28% for 10s; the paired HP ▼2.01% self-cost has no representation (no HP pool at v1 scope) and is carried in `unmodeled`. S2 has two branches: every 150 landed normal attacks, self Critical Damage ▲14.69% for 5s; and an HP-gated ATK conversion (0.96% ATK per 1% Max HP lost) that opens once HP drops below 70%. That conversion is modeled as a self ATK buff opened by a landed-hit threshold, because HP loss in this kit is driven exclusively by S1: 30 landed hits cost 2.01% HP, so 30% HP lost = 15 S1 procs = 450 landed hits, and the buff then grows linearly with further hits — expressed as ⚑86.4% ATK (0.96 × an assumed ~90% Max-HP-lost floor) with a ⚑55s linear ramp from the gate. Burst is a single-target nuke on cast: 1237.5% of final ATK, plus a second 1237.5% hit that only lands once the caster's HP is under 50%, encoded as the same landed-hit proxy (50% lost = 25 S1 procs = 750 landed hits, hitsPerShot 1) via requiresPulls. Both burst hits are crit-eligible and take no core; burst-cast damage is full-burst-exempt by cast timing.

flags.reasoning: The kit gives the CONVERSION RATE (0.96% ATK per 1% Max HP lost) but not the terminal HP loss, which is outside the input domain: it depends on how far self-damage is allowed to drive HP down (a floor at ~1 HP vs a hard stop) and on whether the comp heals. Assuming an unhealed 180s fight where S1 fires often enough to bottom her out, ~90% Max HP lost × 0.96 = 86.4. Lower bound is 28.8 (the gate value, 30% lost); a mid-fight time-average is nearer 55–60.
flags.recipe: Record a solo/no-healer fight and read her HP bar at 30s / 60s / 120s / 180s to get the real HP-lost curve and its floor; multiply the plateau by 0.96 for the terminal ATK, and cross-check against a total-damage A/B with this buff toggled off. If any healer is present, re-derive per comp.

flags.reasoning: HP loss is linear in landed hits (2.01% per 30), so the ATK conversion is a linear ramp, not an instant buff — the primitive matches the mechanic. 55s is the estimated time from the HP<70% gate to the assumed plateau at MG cadence with reloads. Both endpoints are ⚑, and the ramp starts from 0 rather than the true 28.8% gate value, so this under-credits just after the gate.
flags.recipe: Same HP-bar timeline as above: rampSec = (time at plateau) − (time HP first crosses 70%). Prefer replacing the whole construct with a real HP-lost pool if one is ever added to the engine.

flags.reasoning: Proxy for 'HP falls below 70%'. Derived arithmetically from S1: 2.01% HP per 30 landed hits ⇒ 30% lost at 450 hits. Assumes every normal attack lands, no other HP source moves, and no ally healing.
flags.recipe: Frame-read the fight for the moment her HP bar crosses 70% and count her landed rounds to that frame (ammo counter × magazines). If a healer is in the comp the proxy is invalid — the gate may never open.

flags.reasoning: Proxy for 'HP falls below 50%'. Same derivation: 25 S1 procs × 30 landed hits. hitsPerShot is 1, so landed hits ≈ shots fired, which is what requiresPulls counts. Assumes ~100% landing rate; any miss rate pushes the real gate later than this proxy.
flags.recipe: Read the burst popup on each rotation: the second 1237.5% hit appears as a distinct popup only after HP crosses 50%. Count her fired rounds up to the first rotation showing the doubled popup and pin requiresPulls to that number.

flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1 — the datamined cadence field is unreliable, and here it is load-bearing twice over: it sets how often the 30/150-hit triggers fire AND how fast every derived HP threshold (450 / 750) is reached. A wrong cadence shifts both the crit uptime and the entire ATK ramp timing.
flags.recipe: Ammo-counter method — count rounds consumed per second off footage (the instrument that measures shots/sec directly), including MG wind-up, rather than inferring from downstream damage or FB counts.

flags.recipe: Read popup colour on her burst frames — orange + crit icon vs plain white — across several rotations; a mixed set at roughly her sheet crit rate confirms crit-eligible.
